\section*{Online Gradient Descent (OGD)}
\section*{Mathematical Formulation}
The algorithm updates parameters iteratively using the gradient of the current loss function. For convex and L-Lipschitz functions \( f_t(w) \), the update rule is:
\[ w_{t+1} = w_t - \eta_t \nabla f_t(w_t) \]
where \( \eta_t = \frac{1}{\sqrt{t+1}} \) is the time-varying learning rate.

\section*{Pseudocode}
\begin{algorithm}[H]
  \caption{Online Gradient Descent (OGD)}
  \begin{algorithmic}[1]
    \State Initialize \( w_0 \in \mathbb{R}^d \)
    \For{\( t = 0 \) to \( T-1 \)}
      \State Receive \( f_t \in \{ f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_T \} \)
      \State Compute \( g_t = \nabla f_t(w_t) \)
      \State Update \( w_{t+1} = w_t - \frac{1}{\sqrt{t+1}} g_t \)
    \EndFor
  \end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}

\section*{Dry Run Example}
For \( f(w) = (w-3)^2 \), \( w_0 = 0 \):
\begin{itemize}
  \item \( t=0 \): \( w_1 = 0 - \frac{1}{\sqrt{1}}(-6) = 6 \), \( f(w_1) = 9 \)
  \item \( t=1 \): \( w_2 = 6 - \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}(-6) \approx 8.485 \), \( f(w_2) \approx 1.848 \)
  \item \( t=2 \): \( w_3 = 8.485 - \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}(-6) \approx 10.32 \), \( f(w_3) \approx 0.26 \)
\end{itemize}

\section*{Assumptions}
\begin{itemize}
  \item \textbf{Convexity}: \( f_t \) is convex for all \( t \).
  \item \textbf{Lipschitz continuity}: \( \exists L > 0 \) s.t. \( |f_t(w) - f_t(w')| \leq L\|w - w'\| \) for all \( w, w' \).
  \item \textbf{Bounded diameter}: \( \exists D > 0 \) s.t. \( \| w - w' \| \leq D \) for all \( w, w' \in \mathcal{W} \).
\end{itemize}

\section*{Main Convergence Theorem}
The regret \( R(T) = \sum_{t=0}^{T-1} f_t(w_t) - \min_{w \in \mathcal{W}} \sum_{t=0}^{T-1} f_t(w) \) satisfies:
\[ R(T) \leq \frac{D^2}{2} + \sqrt{2LDT} \]

\section*{Theoretical Properties}
- Sublinear regret \( R(T) = O(\sqrt{T}) \)
